status: implemented; disabled without explicit deployment grants; real-service acceptance pending

authentication.credential_owner: trusted backend only; never model tool arguments

authorization.activation: requires explicit deployment/user authorization; no wildcard and no automatic grant

operations.name: medusa.business.product.read.v1
operations.revision: sha256 of canonical JSON {product,summary}; observed snapshot only, not cross-module transaction or write CAS
operations.pricing: native stored price rows, not calculated checkout price; currency amounts are not rescaled; rules and quantity bounds must be honored
operations.inventory: location quantities and kit requirements only; not sales-channel availability, reservation or promise to ship
operations.provenance: native Medusa product and Product Context; internal data, not automatically approved marketing claims

operations.name: medusa.business.context.summary.write.v1

required_body.operation_id: UUID generated and retained by trusted host
required_body.source_hash: 64 lowercase hex from latest read summary.source_hash
required_body.confirmation: sha256 canonical JSON intent; computed only after trusted host obtains user confirmation

operations.canonicalization: recursively sort object keys lexicographically, preserve array order; UTF-8 JSON without whitespace
operations.confirmation_security: digest binds intent, NOT proof of human approval. Host must enforce confirmation and keep native credential private. Do not expose digest-generation/write credential to model.
effects: store operation receipt in existing source_hash
preconditions: existing Product Context required; no implicit create
current numeric version and fresh source hash must match
integer ceiling requires existing admin workflow, never wrap

idempotency.mechanism: atomic CAS on context id/version/source_hash/deleted_at; durable rev:<first32hex of intent digest>:unreviewed receipt
idempotency.retry: replay exact retained body with same actor/product; current matching receipt returns applied without a second mutation
idempotency.after_later_edit: 409; outcome of old operation cannot be proven from current row. Do not retry with new operation ID or fresh revision automatically. Human reconciliation required.
idempotency.scope: latest write receipt only; no permanent operation ledger or universal Idempotency-Key support

operations.on_timeout: retain exact intent and confirmation, mark uncertain; resume exact request only while authorized. 409 remains conflict/uncertain, never report success.

500: native/internal error; write outcome may be uncertain
